name: ecommerceos
description: ECommerceOS — physical retail and e-commerce engine for LifeOS Business

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lifeos/shared && npm run build -w @ecommerceos/shared && npm run build -w @ecommerceos/api
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w @lifeos/shared && npm run build -w @ecommerceos/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push:dev
scripts.test:e2e: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/e2e/portal-provisioning.test.ts && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/e2e/order-lifecycle.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @lifeos/shared && npm run build -w @ecommerceos/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ecommerceos/api
